The bug is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs in `rtl/alu.v`:
1. **SLT** used unsigned comparison (`a < b`) instead of signed comparison — fixed to `$signed(a) < $signed(b)`.
2. **SUB overflow** used `a[7] == b[7]` instead of `a[7] != b[7]` as required by the spec for signed subtraction overflow.
